'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]]. A [[Bridge (Mausoleum)|bridge]] connecting the Mausoleum to mainland Morytania can be built to reach the location for the clue step slightly faster than the traditional route, which requires accessing the [[experiments cave]] instead.
